honest_summary.answer: 100 classes at 200-500 images each is NOT currently supportable. 17 classes are solid (>=150 verified Commons direct files) and 56 reach >=50. Only 9 reach the 200-image floor. Subcategory expansion - unmeasurable while the image hosts are blocked - is the only identified route to closing the gap, and it is unverified.

source.access: API reachable via out-of-sandbox tooling; image hosts (upload.wikimedia.org) BLOCKED from sandbox
source.share_alike_caveat: CC BY-SA is share-alike on the image; effect on trained model weights is legally unsettled

known_gaps: images not downloadable from the sandbox - the biggest unknown
